meta.title: ASN Creation by Vendor (Portal/EDI): refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and attempt ASN Creation by Vendor to verify it is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Vendor and repeat ASN Creation by Vendor to verify it is available.
Compare the two users' role-based access or determine whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and attempt ASN Creation by Vendor to verify it is refused or absent.; Sign in as a Vendor and repeat ASN Creation by Vendor to verify it is available.; Compare the two users' role-based access or determine whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Vendor user, attempt ASN Creation by Vendor and record whether it is refused or absent, then sign in as a Vendor in the same Enterprise tenant and verify the ASN creation action is available
